official_definition: “Barrier When your Life would be reduced, by adding this card to the Hand, you reduce one less Life.” (You can only put up to three Barrier. Besides Barrier, those cards are unaffected by any other effects, and can't be used.)

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Barrier] or [Barrier: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Barrier]", "give [Barrier]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
